title: Chapter 333: World Recovery
content:
Chapter 333: World Recovery

Under Wu Qing's constant guidance, the will of the world rules of the real world successfully descended into the strange sandwich world!

This is an unprecedented event, and all the strange strong men and the powerful strong men of various races in the local camp have noticed this.

A sense of crisis of impending disaster descended on the hearts of all the strange strong men in the dark. At this moment, they dared not to attack Wu Qing.

And all the powerful strong men of various races in the local camp were overjoyed, and a long-lost sense of security surged in their hearts.

"The Zerg really did it! They broke this sandwich world and pulled the will of the world rules in!"

"This time, the Zerg is expected to solve the weird problem in one fell swoop!"

"..."

All the powerful strong men of the local camp seemed to see hope.

The will of the world rules of the real world, as soon as it descended into the strange sandwich world, immediately did one thing, that is, to enhance the strength of Wu Qing and the nine-star soldiers he brought.

Wu Qing suddenly felt that all the suppression of the world rules disappeared, and the real world seemed to open its heart to him, allowing him to comprehend the secrets of the world rules.

A world, even if it has become broken, is not comparable to a living individual. Wu Qing immersed himself in it, and gained a lot in a moment.

Wu Qing's original strength also successfully jumped from the peak state of ten stars to eleven stars, and recovered to the powerful strength of the emperor level.

Wu Qing's strength recovery this time is much stronger than when he was of the same strength.

Not only did Wu Qing gain the favor of the world rule will, but the nine-star arms of the Zerg and Protoss that Wu Qing brought to the weird mezzanine world also gained strength.

Without consuming the system's resources, the strength of all living Zerg and Protoss nine-star arms is rapidly increasing, and soon broke through to the ten-star great power level.

The world rule will of the real world is strong, but it cannot do it by itself, and still needs to rely on Wu Qing and others to take action.

This can also be regarded as a huge reward given by Wu Qing to the world rule will of the real world.

Wu Qing, who had no rivals to begin with, was now even stronger, and brought a group of powerful subordinates with him.

Wu Qing sent out a thought, and with a crackling sound, all the powerful weirds that had been fighting with Wu Qing were blown into a ray of white light and disappeared.

Now that he had powerful subordinates, Wu Qing no longer needed the help of powerful weirds.

"Boom boom...!"

Wu Qing and a group of powerful Zerg and Protoss soldiers did not fight randomly, but specifically attacked the dense areas of weirds.

Each of their attacks shook this weird mezzanine world.

Wu Qing's strength was raised to eleven stars, and those eleven-star weirds hidden in the weird mezzanine world could no longer hide. Wu Qing would send them a blow from time to time, causing the sky to collapse and the earth to crack.

The powerful strongmen of various races in the local camp all felt fear. If they continued to fight like this, this weird mezzanine world might be destroyed in an instant.

But Wu Qing's attack is quickly using the system's ability to eliminate the mysterious external force, allowing the world rules and will of the real world to gradually intervene in this weird sandwich world.

The world rules and will of the real world feel that the virus hidden in its body is disappearing little by little, which gives it hope of successful recovery.

Wu Qing caught the trace of another eleven-star weird. He hit it with one move, almost causing the weird to completely collapse. It had to use the weak space barrier to run into the real world.

The weird that ran to the real world, no matter how strong it is, has to be suppressed by the world rules and will, and can no longer make much waves.

A large number of powerful weirds were found by Wu Qing and killed one by one. Countless weirds disappeared by the attack of Wu Qing and the powerful Zerg and Protoss.

Not long after, all the powerful weirds in the weird sandwich world, under the strong pressure of Wu Qing, did not care about the suppression of the world rules and will of the real world, and ran to the real world to survive.

Seeing this situation, the powerful people of the major races in the local camp packed up and returned to the real world, letting the weird mezzanine world out.

The area of the weird mezzanine world is very large. After no external interference, the Queen of Insects took action together. It was like the "God" of this world. The spiritual power that was so powerful that it could destroy the world descended on this world. Countless weird things could not bear the oppression of this spiritual power and exploded one after another!

There is no need for Wu Qing and the powerful insect and god tribes to take action. Once the Queen of Insects's thoughts passed, all the weird things were destroyed and turned into light.

Soon, there was no weird thing in the entire weird mezzanine world.

This weird mezzanine world, which originally belonged to the real world, except for a weak trace of external forces, which still needed the will of the world rules to clear, all other external forces were converted into system resources by the system.

The mysterious external force that even the world's rules could not destroy was easily solved by Wu Qing using the system.

Wu Qing could feel that without the interference of this external force, the world had begun to recover.

As soon as the Zerg took action, they eliminated the biggest hidden danger in this world. This achievement is so great that no one can imagine it.

The Zerg and the Protoss, as well as the Great Xia Territory, the Alliance, and various personnel actually affiliated with the Zerg, have obtained world rule authority that exceeds the status of super clans.

A large number of Zerg and Protoss soldiers have spontaneously broken through star-level strength in combat, and various members of the Zerg have also experienced explosive breakthroughs in strength.

The Zerg has become the de facto largest race in this world, and its status has surpassed that of a super clan.

…

After Wu Qing solved the problem of the weird mezzanine world, he returned to the Zerg base camp and used the authority opened by the will of the world rules to study the power of the world rules and continue to improve his cultivation system.

The entire real world has undergone tremendous changes because of the actions of the Zerg.

The biggest change is the influence of the weirdness on this world. In the current world, at night, the weird haziness has disappeared.

Although there are still some weirdness at night, there is no such situation of weirdness rampant.

All the weirdness in the mezzanine weird world was destroyed, and the surviving powerful weirdness all fled to the real world. The situation where the mysterious external force used weirdness to interfere with this world no longer exists.

This world has changed.
